facts.fact: 焚翼合战：Julian 火符箭+Angelica 火炮夹击——「羽毛卷曲成灰」；Risha 尸兵（含融合体）、Ulshära/Cosima 剑劈、Dante 影镰——皆不够；Orsus「You struggle, and for what? You have seen what we can do.」——「他们重写现实——他仍无法相信那令人作呕的确定：他被夺走自主、只为神证明一个观点」；他反呛「Use me, then」——Dante 不安；Orsus「I do not wish—」被「黑静电之柱的 bass-throb」吞没——「Oh. How tragic.」

日蚀：黑柱「如穿过 Aurora 的反物质——食与抹并行」——「直刺三阳之一」；Ulshära 惨叫、Angelica 扶住她——「黑柱凿穿太阳、没入其后的虚无。柱散——只剩一弯 pitiful crescent. A celestial shell.」；记忆「沙漠中 Third Sun 攀升、Nikolas 跪沙、举手迎它为 Merciful Nikai——讽刺无人错过」；Dante 黑瞳映残月「What has she done?」；神庙深吼——「三阳 flickering——Phos 的专注断了；周身之翼收缩」

光造巨神：「STARSCOURGE. ONCE AGAIN LIVING UP TO YOUR BLIGHTED NAME.」——羽翼锐化成刀、哀嚎的悲愤让剩余二阳增亮；三阳凝成光束击广场——「monstrous shape 自光粒子显形：鸟形、后腿钩爪、人身躯、四条长臂、胸臂覆羽、头戴 corona 形尖盔（类 imperator 面具）、双对之翼折射联合光束成 variegated 碎片」——「四手各折一支神庙之翼为矛。LET ME RETURN THE FAVOR.」

Nikolas 的「GO」：Julian 弃箭冲向 Taesia——Orsus 不必强迫——「他自愿抬手、欲为她再度改写现实」——halo 在幻影与 Taesia 之间爆发——缩成 Nikolas 周身的 nimbus（Sunbringer Spear 在手、新翼全展）——「His eyes—both of them, somehow——纯然 austere 的金球」——对 Taesia 冷言「GO.」——扑向幻影（以翼兵架住矛）——「How is he…?」
facts.anchor: His eyes—both of them, somehow—were nothing but austere orbs of gold.

facts.fact: 「It's just me」：Taesia 不动——galaxy eyes 追踪战局；Julian 握她腕脉「so distant it could have been years away」「It's just me. It's just me and it's just you.」；「夜与它的地平线。门与它的插销。初夏在他们汗里、她的呼吸像晚冬——兽与神的骨头横在他们与尚未穿过的季节之间」；「怪神很容易——忽略体内每一段渴望杀戮的静音部分则难。他说不出口 it's not your fault——因为其中一部分是他的」
facts.anchor: It’s just me and it’s just you.

facts.fact: Edwin 的粉丝时刻与 Fin 的王相时刻：Edwin 茶壶哨「The Sunslayer actually slayed the sun——Mistress Sunslayer, please, I am a longtime admirer—」；「Not the time. We need to get to the god's body while Nik holds him off out here.」；Rian「I'll help him.」——Fin「No, you won't.」——Julian「瞥见 King Ferdinand 的影子」；Taesia 低声「Phos may possess him again.」；Rian「He might. But it's a risk we have to take. And you know what to do if that happens.」——「连 Julian 都被他的决心撼动（骨镯泛恼意）」；Edwin 想要签名被拖走

Nikolas 的神化与「Together」：Taesia 望 Nikolas 与 Phos 的残影——「aura 更大、且 somehow 古老——like he'd become a god himself.」；「Nyx wants me to stay. To tear them both down in one strike.」；Starfell 蒸腾、寒能放大（Noctus 的冷重天穹）——「The sun—」「Phos will be weaker without it.」「The realm—」「Will be free once you complete your mission. The reason you came here sits in the temple. Let's be rid of it.」——Orsus 之赞未使他退缩「If Nikolas and Taesia could bear the weight of their gods, so could he.」；她攥紧他的手、闭眼再睁——「eyes clear」——「Together, then.」
facts.anchor: like he’d become a god himself.
